name: Iridescent Aria
effect: Restores 34% of Max HP to the selected character and regenerates 980 HP every 5s for 30s.
description: Vodyanitsa's specialty. This crystal-clear drink served in an antique pearl-adorned goblet glows with a dreamy radiance. Give it a gentle swirl, and a veil of tiny bubbles rises to the surface before bursting one by one, as though someone in the water has just let out peals of laughter. Could this wonder be the work of some mysterious melody she was humming while it simmered?
